description: This file provides an internal storage implementation for a software project, supporting SQLite and PostgreSQL. It includes schema creation, migrations, error types, and data retrieval/storage functions for workflows, runs, events, steps, and verifiable credentials (VCs). It also manages database migrations, indexing, and Vector Store initialization with support for different storage modes and schema updates.
